hero.title: Steppenwolf

info.paragraph1: Published in 1927, Steppenwolf is considered one of Hermann Hesse's most autobiographical works. While Demian explores the duality between good and evil, Steppenwolf dives into the existential loneliness of Harry Haller.
info.paragraph2: Together, these two books form a complete portrait of Hesse's philosophical view on the human condition. A collection that no literature lover should be without.
info.title: Why Steppenwolf?

offer.description: Steppenwolf is one of Hesse's most introspective works. A collector's edition that perfectly complements Demian.
